name: ppt-anything
description: Create, research, edit, and export image-native slide decks from Codex with scenario workflows, Design Files, brand systems, and a live in-editor Browser workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Operate complete, scenario- and brand-aware slide workflows in Codex.
interface.longDescription: PPT Anything gives Codex the full presentation workflow through both a portable Agent Skill and 27 typed MCP tools: 24 scenario presets with semantic source slots, research and onboarding, outline creation, project Design Files, always-on brand design systems, visual inspiration, image-native slide generation, conversational and mark-based editing, slide structure controls, live Browser preview, presenting, and PDF/PPTX export.
defaultPrompt: Open PPT Anything in the Codex Browser.
Show me the scenario catalog and use the best workflow for my source files.
Open this deck's Design Files or brand design system and update it.
Research this topic, build a deck, and open the live preview.
Edit my latest deck and show the result in the Browser.
